text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin has convinced herself that<n>her sisters'
dream is to dance. And<n>she remains sure of that
until the<n>Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her sisters scold her for deciding<n>their dreams for
them, and insist that<n>what they really want is for her
to<n>keep racing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her coworkers feel the same, seeing<n>their own
dreams in her running.<n>Ines's races touch people's
hearts.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She decides to run in the Arima Kinen<n>against such
strong opponents as<n>Oguri Cap and Mejiro Ryan,
and with<n>the dreams of her family—and<n>everyone
else—on her shoulders!
